notes: DECISION: two things the reviewer should weigh. (1) Every PostalDataPI raster above 32px has the black 'POSTAL DATA' lettering under the pin; on the dark tile that lettering shows only as a thin outline (the pin itself reads fine), and no white version is published. The pin alone exists only as favicon-32x32.png (downloads/postal-data-api/p4-1, too small) and as favicon.svg. (2) That SVG favicon draws the 'i' as live <text> in a sans-serif font, which the rules exclude, so it doesn't qualify; the first pass's downloads/postal-data-api/final/postal-data-api.svg came from it and should not ship.
